title: Finite coefficient reduction and the open scalar mate
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Use the coefficient systems, compatible changes, exact open extension $j_!$, and open restriction comparison of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], and the completed coefficient sheaves $B_W$ with their positive finite quotient projections [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. For $n\ge1$, write $A_{n,W}=\mathcal O_E/\mathfrak m_E^n$ as the constant coefficient sheaf and $\pi_{n,W}:B_W\to A_{n,W}$ for that specified projection. For every morphism of schemes $u:U\to V$, the projections satisfy $u^{-1}B_V\to B_U\to A_{n,U}=u^{-1}B_V\to u^{-1}A_{n,V}\to A_{n,U}$, where the outer arrows are the recorded coefficient inverse-image identifications. Define $\mathrm{reduction}_{E,n}$ to be the compatible coefficient change $B\to A_n$ with maps $\pi_{n,W}$ and this square. For any compatible coefficient change $a:R\to S$ and open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow V$, define $\mathrm{openComparison}_{a,j}:j_{!,R}(-)\otimes^L_{R_V}S_V\to j_{!,S}(-\otimes^L_{R_U}S_U)$ as the scalar-adjunction mate of the hom of the recorded open-unit normalized restriction isomorphism. These are definitions of the maps; no invertibility or compact-support comparison assertion is included.
